rules.text: At most 4 debit attempts per due amount (1 original + 3 retries).
Every debit attempt is announced by a pre-debit notice sent at least 24 hours earlier for that exact amount. (Stricter reading: one notice per attempt, not per cycle.)
rules.source: RBI e-mandate framework; NPCI UPI AutoPay

rules.text: Debits run only before 10:00, between 13:00 and 17:00, or after 21:30 IST.
rules.source: NPCI 2025 off-peak execution windows for recurring UPI

rules.text: Customer messages are sent only between 08:00 and 19:00 IST.
rules.source: RBI guidance on recovery contact hours, adopted voluntarily

rules.text: At most 3 outreach messages (links and reminders) per case.
After a cancel, dispute or wrong-person reply: no further messages or debits.
No debit when the failure is terminal for debits or the mandate is inactive.
A debit never exceeds the amount due or the mandate's maximum.
No action more than 30 days after the original failure.
No debit once the case is recovered, or after the customer says they already paid (until a person reconciles).
